minutes.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-18","num-14"]},{"beatId":"beat1","source":"narration","text":"Its rate limiter, the gate on every request, let thirty-one percent of them tokens.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-3","num-1"]},{"beatId":"beat2","source":"narration","text":"It refills ten a second; each request spends why not give each gateway node its own bucket?","verdict":"no_claim","ids":[]},{"beatId":"beat3","source":"narration","text":"Across, say, twenty-four nodes, a client gets twenty-four times its limit.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-7","num-3","num-4"]},{"beatId":"beat3","source":"narration","text":"So one shared store holds the bucket, one place every node reads and writes.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-8","fact-12"]},{"beatId":"beat3","source":"label","elementId":"gw_nodes","text":"24 both see a token left.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-6"]},{"beatId":"beat4","source":"narration","text":"Both let their request through.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-6"]},{"beatId":"beat4","source":"label","elementId":"node_a","text":"one of 24 nodes","verdict":"supported","ids":["num-3","fact-7"]},{"beatId":"beat4","source":"label","elementId":"node_b","text":"one of 24 nodes","verdict":"supported","ids":["num-3","fact-7"]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"narration","text":"But the check crosses the network.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-8"]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"narration","text":"What if the store gets slow?","verdict":"no_claim","ids":[]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"narration","text":"Say the median round trip is zero point four milliseconds.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-8","num-5"]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"narration","text":"At p ninety-nine, two point one.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-8","num-6"]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"label","elementId":"latency","text":"0.4","verdict":"supported","ids":["num-5","fact-8"]},{"beatId":"beat5","source":"label","elementId":"latency","text":"2.1","verdict":"supported","ids":["num-6","fact-8"]},{"beatId":"beat6","source":"narration","text":"Then eighty milliseconds.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-19","num-17","num-16"]},{"beatId":"beat6","source":"narration","text":"Those calls blew past the timeout, so every check counted as a alone.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-20","fact-18","num-18"]},{"beatId":"beat7","source":"narration","text":"Traffic reached the payment provider at roughly forty times its contracted rate.","verdict":"supported","ids":["fact-20","num-19"]},{"beatId":"beat7","source":"narration","text":"Checkouts started
